provenance.paper: L. London and E. Fauchon-Jones, arXiv:1708.00404
provenance.recipe: fresh London HM assembly through an explicit diagnostic adapter
provenance.eq14_carrier_contract: HM QNM values define the outer frequency map; Eq. (14) uses the D carrier absolute fRD_D and fdamp_D with HM ratios R and T, then C1 completes at 0.5*fRD_D.
provenance.adapter_scope: The adapter replaces only parity_harness.get_fd_waveform for IMRPhenomHM during this process and is restored before exit; production routing is unchanged.
provenance.strict_gate_scope: The unchanged parity gates are run strictly for the original catalog and holdout HM rows. Independent rows are raw diagnostic comparisons.
provenance.n61_provenance: N=61 is a grid metadata hypothesis inferred from published coefficient intervals; this report does not certify inherited coefficient provenance.
provenance.clean_room_scope: No LAL/PyCBC/TEOB implementation or author implementation was copied; LAL is used only as the public binary comparison target through parity_harness.

report_provenance.paper: L. London and E. Fauchon-Jones, arXiv:1810.03550v2
report_provenance.source: published rendered paper plus the fresh independent Leaver continued-fraction solver
report_provenance.solver_source: scripts/kerr_leaver_solver.py: independent radial continued fraction and spheroidal angular eigenproblem
report_provenance.paper_convention: tilde{omega}=omega_r+i/tau; independent roots conjugated before fit
report_provenance.clean_room_scope: No LAL, PyCBC, TEOB implementation, author implementation, oracle-fitting, calibration files, waveform outputs, or public target binary used
report_provenance.historical_limit: The paper does not specify the historical training count or all GMVP selections; this is a bounded independent reconstruction.
report_provenance.count_hypothesis: N=61 is a metadata hypothesis inferred from public coefficient rounding, not a published fact.
report_provenance.count_uncertainty: A different historical training count, node ordering, hidden GMVP subset, precision, or fit preprocessing could produce different coefficients; this run does not identify those unpublished choices.

choices.independent_cases: exactly the four CASES from diagnose_hm_qnm_leaver_clean.py

execution.next_check: inspect report.json after the bounded diagnostic completes
